dedupe_keys.name: btk annual statistical bulletin of electronic communications by province turkiye 81 provinces

description: The Information and Communication Technologies Authority publishes an annual statistical bulletin on the electronic communications sector at province level, answering requests for regional data that its national quarterly reports do not meet. Each edition covers a rolling six-year window, and the page lists editions from 2007-2012 to 2020-2025, each as a PDF and an Excel workbook (the 2020-2025 PDF has 91 pages in Turkish and English; its workbook is about 0.8 MB). For each of the 81 provinces the bulletin gives mobile subscriptions, fixed and broadband internet subscriptions by technology and fibre optic cable length, with national totals. Headline figures in the 2020-2025 edition: mobile subscriptions rose 21 percent to 99.7 million, broadband subscriptions 18 percent to 97.4 million, and fibre cable length 60 percent to 681 thousand km. Istanbul, Ankara, İzmir, Bursa and Antalya are the largest provinces. Coverage: Türkiye by province, 2007 to 2025. Format and access: PDF and XLSX, free. Caveats: annual values only; overlapping six-year windows mean earlier values may be revised between editions; not every indicator was checked in the workbook. Simulation uses: province-level demand and fibre network extent for regional network models, and exposure of telecom assets in earthquake-affected provinces such as those hit in February 2023. Related records: the BTK electronic communications market data give the national quarterly series; the building damage datasets for the 2023 Türkiye earthquake and the Turkey-Syria 2023 earthquake impact estimates give hazard context.
